description: Angular component for configuring related attributes in a rule node, including form handling, configuration preparation, and translation support.

classes.name: RelatedAttributesConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for related attributes configuration in rule nodes.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for related attributes configuration.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and trims the output configuration object based on dataToFetch type.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration with default mappings and fetch type based on input configuration.

methods.name: selectTranslation
methods.description: Selects the appropriate translation string based on dataToFetch value.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form fields that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on dataToFetch value.
